Preflight Demo Program
2026-09-28
DOC-0006
Duplicate Merge Notes Preserve Both Issue References
POLICY
Effective date: 2026-09-28
Custodian: PERSON-0033, TEAM-0003
Scope: Administrative handling of suspected duplicate issue entries.
— Compare the questions and scope before proposing a merge. Similar
subsystem labels or similar titles are not enough. The queue coordinator
records why the entries appear to describe the same coordination concern
and asks the originating desks to resolve any difference in scope.
~ Keep both issue IDs on the cover sheet. Mark which entry will carry the
continuing discussion and which reference leads to the originating
submission. Never erase an older reference merely because its paper is filed
behind the keeper.
~ Write a merge note with the date, participating desk roles, reason for
choosing the keeper, and destination of any remaining administrative
action. Preserve each originating question in its received form so that a later
reader can reconstruct the decision.
— Use the keeper and origin tabs introduced by the program's duplicate-note
trial. File the merge rationale behind the keeper tab and the source material
behind origin. The tab names describe filing relationships, not a record's
current category.
~ Escalate disputed scope to the queue chair before combining the papers.
ISSUE-0128 and TASK-0844 are locating references for the hydraulics desk
layout; no duplicate partner is asserted by this policy.
Revision note: The trial's keeper and origin tabs are retained, with an explicit
requirement to preserve both issue references.
D. Worker 0033
Demo Worker 0033, Demo Team 03
Page 1 of 1
